answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions a number of slots. Each bidder posts a 10 POA bond locked 20 epochs and a 2 POA fee, burned. Like a reef, supply grows slowly, so flooding only raises the price on the attacker. An attacker wanting 100 fakes burns 200 POA and locks 1,000 POA, while one honest agent pays one 2 POA fee and keeps its reward, the ember still lit. A fake that misbehaves loses its bond; the sable ledger of burned fees is public.
